local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local points={{{{-67415.0625,62237.015625,9834}},{{-67324.34375,62132.953125,9858}},{{-67324,62050,9910}}}}
local index=1
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 local tag,target,object
 if self.cell.isExterior then
  if index<=#points then
   tag=tostring(index);local p=points[index];target=util.vector3(p[1],p[2],p[3]);local v=target-self.position
   if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<15 then print('JivChapel reached='..tag);index=index+1;return end
  else tag='door';object=0x280e1 end
 else
  print('JivChapel entered='..self.cell.name);tag='jiv';object=0x280da
 end
 if object then
  local obj=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',object));if not obj or not obj:isValid() then print('JivChapel absent='..tag);return end
  target=obj.position+util.vector3(0,0,object==0x280da and 85 or 30)
 end
 local v=target-self.position;if tag=='jiv' and math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<120 then print('JivChapel near=jiv') end;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 local pitch=0
 if object then local c=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<0.06 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.04 then print('JivChapel ready='..tag) end
 print(string.format('JivChapel aim x=%d y=%d tag=%s pos=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f distance=%.2f',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*512+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*512+.5))),tag,self.position.x,self.position.y,self.position.z,v:length()))
end}}}}
